reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in her DM to confirm. Her dock for Thornbury Cloth Co. pickups on the Nettle project is now saved as Bay 46.

I also fixed a privacy problem. The workspace brain (gbrain) had automatically saved her DM as a fact with **world** visibility, which means other members could have seen it. I saved a new copy marked **private** to her, then deleted the world-visible copy. She and the note itself say "private," which is what she'd expect for something she told me in a DM.

I couldn't confirm the private copy by reading it back: my connection to the brain only returns world-visible facts. The save did report success. When I deleted the old copy, the brain warned that it can only catch exact duplicates. If anything else from her DM was saved in different wording, I wouldn't have found it.
